title: Words as Database Tokens (Schema Refactor)
description: Words should be treated as unique tokens/enums in the database, NOT as per-sentence instances. When "دل" appears in line 3 and line 7, they MUST share the same learning state.

acceptanceCriteria.text: CONTEXT7 FIRST: Use `mcp__Context7__query-docs` to research Convex schema best practices for unique word tokens (US-WORD-SYNC already implemented this)
Verify `convex/schema.ts` has proper indexes on `words` table by `persian` field (has `by_visitor_persian` index)
Verify `wordProgress` table uses `persian` field (not `wordId`) as the word identifier (schema line 55, 63)
Query `wordProgress.getByVisitorPersian` returns same state for same Persian word regardless of which line it came from (verified in wordProgress.ts)
Test: Mark word "برای" as learned on Line 1 → Line 2 shows same "learned" state (browser verified!)
Verify in browser: same word across lines shows consistent state (bidirectional sync verified!)
